Hi Sara — thanks for the sample and welcome aboard.

Short answer: we prefer portal-based invoice ingestion for automation (faster ACKs and automatic PO stitching), but we do support an email fallback for suppliers that cannot use the portal immediately. Below are the actionable bits:

1) Portal (recommended):
- Please complete the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) — that flow registers your vendor entity and links your default remit-to.
- Once registered you'll get a vendor portal account where CSV/CSV+PDF uploads are processed and give an automated acknowledgement (ACK) with an invoice id.

2) Email fallback (acceptable short term):
- Send invoices to invoices+{SUBJECT_TOKEN}@invoices.redwood.com. Use the SUBJECT_TOKEN pattern: GF-{PO}-{VENDID}. Example: GF-PO123456-GF001.
- Filename: include the invoice number and PO (e.g., INV_20260930_PO123456.pdf).
- Attachments: single PDF per message preferred. If you must send multiple invoices in one email, include a CSV (sample_invoice_template.csv attached) mapping filenames to PO lines.

3) Minimum required fields for matching:
- PO number (exact match)
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- Line totals (or a CSV breakdown)

I attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and a sample CSV template to make this easier. If you complete the form, we can fast-track a portal account within 2 business days.

Next steps: can you (a) confirm whether you'll complete the onboarding form, or (b) if you need to use email for the first month and then migrate to the portal? If email, please send one sample using the SUBJECT_TOKEN pattern so our ops team can validate parsing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sara — Jordan on Procurement Ops. Quick answers and a proposed plan so you can close your month: 

1) Additional channels:
- SFTP: supported (sftp.redwood.com – we'll provide credentials after onboarding). Preferred for batch nightly pushes (CSV+PDF).
- API push (inbound webhook) is currently in private beta — we can discuss if you want to join, but SFTP or portal is faster to set up.

2) Onboarding form:
- If you can complete the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf with remit and tax details, that's ideal (fastest). If not, send the minimal fields (vendor name, remit address, primary AP email, sample PO number) and we'll finish it on our side.

3) Email fallback SLA and exceptions:
- Email-parsed invoices are ACKed within 24 hours if they meet the SUBJECT_TOKEN and required fields. If parsing fails, an ops ticket is generated; resolution target is 3 business days (we'll escalate for month-end).
- For October close we can manual-review any failed matches within 48 hours if you flag the message subject with URGENT-MO.

4) Subject token & filename checklist (please use exactly):
- SUBJECT line: GF-PO{PO#}-GF{VendorShortID} e.g. GF-PO123456-GF001
- Filename: INV_{InvoiceNumber}_PO{PO#}.pdf e.g. INV_90021_PO123456.pdf

5) Drop us one test email today with your typical attachment and the SUBJECT_TOKEN. We'll validate and confirm parsing. Once validated, payment timing follows our standard Net30 from invoice date.

Attached: ack_spec.pdf with ACK JSON example and mapping rules.

If you want, Vanessa will open your portal account once the form is complete and send SFTP credentials if you choose that path.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.
Jordan Blake
